name: robotics-mcp
description: Unified robotics control via MCP - Physical and virtual robots (bot + vbot). Dreame D20 Pro vacuum, Yahboom ROSMASTER, Moorebot Scout, Unitree Go2/G1, Elegoo, Gazebo, Hue HomeAware, virtual robots in Unity/VRChat/Resonite, drone fleet (PX4/ArduPilot), sim fleet orchestration (MuJoCo/Gazebo/Isaac/LimX), manufacturing (3D printers/CNC/laser cutters), environmental logistics, CAD/SPZ conversion, fleet art bridges.

config_path.title: Configuration File Path
config_path.description: Path to robotics-mcp config YAML file (optional, uses default if empty)

http_enabled.title: Enable HTTP Server
http_enabled.description: Enable HTTP API alongside stdio (default: false for Claude Desktop)

tools.name: robotics_system
tools.description: System management portmanteau - help, status, list_robots with filtering

tools.name: robot_control
tools.description: Unified robot control - get_status, move, stop, return_to_dock, stand, sit, walk, sync_vbot, plus Yahboom (home_patrol, camera_capture, arm_move, gripper_control, navigate_to, ai_query), Dreame (start/stop_cleaning, clean_zone, clean_room, clean_spot, go_to, get_map, set_suction_level, set_water_volume, set_mop_humidity, start_mapping, start_fast_mapping, rename_room, set_cleaning_sequence, set_restricted_zones, get_cleaning_history, clear_error), Elegoo (emergency_stop), Hue HomeAware (hue_get_movement_events/sensor_status/movement_zones), and Gazebo operations

tools.name: robot_behavior
tools.description: Robot behavior portmanteau - animation (set_wheel_speeds, play_animation, set_pose, stop_animation, get_animation_state), camera (get_camera_feed, get_virtual_camera, set_camera_angle, capture_image, start_streaming, stop_streaming, get_camera_status), navigation (plan_path, follow_path, set_waypoint, clear_waypoints, get_path_status, avoid_obstacle, get_current_path), manipulation (move_joints, move_end_effector, control_gripper, set_force_limit, get_manipulation_status, stop_manipulation)

tools.name: robot_manufacturing
tools.description: Manufacturing equipment control - 3D printers, CNC machines, laser cutters with control, monitor, and maintenance operations

tools.name: robot_virtual
tools.description: Virtual robot lifecycle - create, read, update, delete, list, spawn, load_environment, get_status, get_lidar, set_scale, test_navigation, sync_with_physical across Unity, VRChat, Resonite

tools.name: vbot_crud
tools.description: Virtual robot CRUD - create, read, update, delete, list with support for scout, scout_e, go2, g1, yahboom, mechazilla, godzilla, drone, px4_quad, ardupilot, robbie, custom types

tools.name: robot_model
tools.description: Robot model management - create, import, export, convert (FBX/GLB/OBJ/VRM/BLEND), SPZ check/convert/extract/install, execute scripts

tools.name: drone_control
tools.description: Drone flight operations - arm, disarm, takeoff, land, RTL, move, goto_global, goto_local, set_mode, get_status, get_battery, get_gps, get_attitude, mission control, streaming (start/stop FPV, capture, record), navigation (set waypoints, mission planning, geofence), flight control modes, servo control

tools.name: dreame_control
tools.description: Dedicated Dreame D20 Pro Plus vacuum control - DreameHome cloud operations: status, cleaning, auto-empty, self-clean, suction/water/mop settings, zone/room/spot cleaning, mapping, map export (OBJ/PLY/Unity JSON/Blender Python)

tools.name: gazebo_models
tools.description: Gazebo Fuel model browser - search, download, spawn, list_local, delete_local for 3000+ free simulation assets

tools.name: noetix_info
tools.description: Noetix Bumi humanoid robot - specs (94cm, 12kg, 21DOF), features, SDK links

tools.name: cad_converter
tools.description: CAD file converter - convert STEP/STP/IGES to OBJ/STL/PLY/GLTF/GLB for Blender

tools.name: spz_converter
tools.description: SPZ Gaussian splat converter - check, convert (PLY/JSON), extract, install into Unity projects

tools.name: robotics_sim_art
tools.description: Sim-art fleet bridge via gimp-mcp HTTP - gimp_status, batch_gazebo_icons, import_gazebo_models, batch_vrchat_icons, avatar_thumbnail

tools.name: robotics_fab_art
tools.description: Fab-art fleet bridge via inkscape-mcp HTTP - inkscape_status, batch_dxf_export, batch_laser_dots, gazebo_schematic, stage_fab_paths, push_gimp_schematic

tools.name: robotics_agentic_workflow
tools.description: Complex multi-step robotics workflows using MCP sampling (FastMCP 3.1+) - autonomous mission orchestration

tools.name: environmental_logistics_handler
tools.description: Specialized robotic logistics - stiffen_fabric, grip_textile, manipulate_pattern, darkroom_logistics, diy_construction, facade_maintenance, garden_logistics, security_patrol, pet_logistics, human_health_supervision, companion_logistics, mural_painting, emergency_dispatch

tools.name: workflow_management
tools.description: Workflow lifecycle - create, read, update, delete, list, execute, status, templates, import, export, validate, schedule, unschedule, get_scheduled

tools.name: sim_fleet_status
tools.description: Probe all registered simulation backend MCP servers (MuJoCo, Gazebo, Isaac, LimX)

tools.name: sim_fleet_route
tools.description: Route a simulation task to the best available backend based on capability matching

tools.name: sim_fleet_backends
tools.description: List all registered sim backends and their capabilities (offline registry)

tools.name: sim_marketplace_search_tool
tools.description: Search robot model marketplace by keyword, tags, sim backend compatibility, or robot type
